y-m-66-09.topic: Izindlela zokuhlanganisa: ukukhetha izindima ekuhlanganiseni umkhiqizo
y-m-66-09.goal: Qhathanisa ukuthi ekuhlanganiseni umkhiqizo, zombili izinketho ze-"yisiphi isici okufanele sihlukaniswe nokuthi isiphi sihlanganiswe" zinikeza izibalo ezilungile kodwa esisodwa singaba ngcono noma sibe sibi kuye ngenhloso, bese uchaza umthetho wokukhetha ngezibonelo ezimbili.
y-m-66-09.material: Abantu ababili bazama ukuthola ∫ x·e^x dx. (Ifundwa: i-integral ka-x izikhathi e to the power of x, dx. Lapha e^x yimsebenzi we-exponential. Sebenzisa ifomula evela ezidingweni ezingenhla.) UHayun: vumela f = x no-g′ = e^x, kunikeza x·e^x − ∫ e^x dx = x·e^x − e^x + C. UDohyun: vumela f = e^x no-g′ = x, futhi wabhala kuze kube ngu-(x²/2)·e^x − ∫ (x²/2)·e^x dx wamisa. Izinhlangothi zesokudla zezibalo zombili zivela efomulweni.
